item.title: Browns’ Myles Garrett unanimous choice for AP NFL Defensive Player of the Year; Carson Schwesinger wins DROY
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO — Myles Garrett was a unanimous choice for the AP NFL Defensive Player of the Year award after setting a season record for sacks with 23. Garrett received all 50 first-place votes to become the ninth player to win DPOY multiple times. Cleveland’s edge rusher also was a unanimous All-Pro selection. Garrett previously won the award in 2023. “It doesn’t just start with me,” he said. “It starts with great teammates, a great organization, great coaches being able to put us in position.

item.title: Tilly, Thornton, combine for 36 as Ohio State rolls, 82-62, past Maryland
item.description: COLLEGE PARK, Md. — Christoph Tilly and Bruce Thornton combined for 36 points as Ohio State beat Maryland, 82-62, on Feb. 5. Tilly had 19 on 7-of-10 shooting for the Buckeyes (15-7 7-5 Big Ten). Thornton shot 7 of 9 to finish with 17. John Mobley Jr. added 15 points, four assists and two steals. He was 5 of 9 from deep, continuing his streak of making at least one 3-pointer in every game this season. Taison Chatman added 10 points before he was ejected.
